title: E1b: docs for the new review policy — CLAUDE.md, planner.md, README, orchestrate skill
spec: After E1 (T-0210) lands, the rule text must match the code. Update the review rule in CLAUDE.md (Always step 7 and the Never line about self-review), .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md (the copy that tests/test_daemon.py::test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists compares), README.md Pipeline paragraph, and skills/planner/orchestrate/SKILL.md step 7 to say: gate = tests green + hooks; no code review by default; one review on security_review_tier (never the executing model, security checklist always) when the diff touches pool.toml [review] security_paths; spec review from complexity 6 on sonnet stays; orphaned results get one review; the human reviews every PR. Mention pipeline.review_reason. Remove the 4-6 / 7-10 review tiers text. Keep the CLAUDE.md line count within 3 lines of today's (it loads into every Planner turn).
acceptance: grep -n 'security_paths' CLAUDE.md README.md .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md skills/planner/orchestrate/SKILL.md each return at least one line
No remaining text promising 'cross-model adversarial' reviews for complexity 7-10 in the four files
